snippet.title: Hexen Vestiges of Grandeur Gameplay - 01 Temple Outskirts
snippet.description:
Gameplay from the new official Hexen remastered episode Vestiges of Grandeur. Cleric, pope difficulty, no commentary. This is part of a full walkthrough: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoxV-no_tlqxXZFiQxo0yARAv7zW559qh

Vestiges of Grandeur is featured in the new Heretic + Hexen official re-release of the games, including a whole new episode with new puzzles and hubs, and a couple of surprises.
------
Gameplay del nuevo episodio remasterizado oficial de Hexen, Vestiges of Grandeur. Clérigo, dificultad Pope, sin comentarios de voz.

Vestiges of Grandeur forma parte del nuevo relanzamiento oficial de Heretic + Hexen, e incluye un episodio completamente nuevo con nuevos acertijos, hubs y un par de sorpresas.
